silhouette: Stout rounded body with a flat circular base, tapering upward into a distinct neck, flanked by an arched side handle and an angled upward-pointing spout opposite.

parts.name: body
parts.shape: flattened sphere with a wide flat circular base and a short vertical collar at the top
parts.connection: seamlessly transitions downward to the base and upward to the collar

parts.name: spout
parts.shape: elongated tapered cylinder curving upward and outward with a diagonal opening at the tip
parts.connection: welded to the upper side of the main body

parts.name: handle
parts.shape: thick curved semi-circular strap with flattened ends
parts.connection: attached at two points vertically along the side of the body opposite the spout

parts.name: lid
parts.shape: domed circular disc featuring a central spherical knob and a stepped flange underneath
parts.connection: fitted snugly inside the vertical collar opening at the top of the body

recognitionCues: metallic sheen lines following the curvature of the spherical body
clear junction where the upward-angled spout meets the side
closed fitted lid with a centered knob indicating interior volume
arched structural handle positioned opposite the pouring spout
